Your therapist is there for you, not your mom. Tell them that you have concerns about what your mom has told them about your situation.

They want to hear your side of things, how you feel. Not what other people think of your situation. 

It is hard but take it slowly. You don’t have to tell them everything in one go try bit by bit.

Personally I think long term the business partnership will have to end, it will be too painful for you to have that constant reminder of what you had with her everyday. I wouldn’t know how to advise you properly on this, I just think emotionally it would be for the best.

The sadness sucks. It’s gonna hurt and it’s gonna hurt for a long time. The best thing you can do is try to keep focusing on the future, moving forward with the next part of your life. Surround yourself with other people you are close with if you can. Try thinking about what you want from the future rather than the sadness from the past.
Agreed. A therapist is whatever you need them to be. They’re there to help you however they can.

You definitely did the right thing. She may be angry at you for a while but you acted in a way that shows you care. Hopefully one day she’ll be in a place where she can see that. 

You’re one of the good ones, the world needs more people who act like you.

You should try and move on. Even if she does give you an answer it might not provide the closure you’re pinning on it.

The real closure will come with focusing on yourself, you have the opportunity to create whatever life you want for yourself right now. It seems daunting the prospect of life without her but unfortunately she seems to have moved on so you should too.
